wishes: Planner defaults (Pavel gave only the genre and title): sunny tropical-island adventure for families; exploration and treasure, no weapons, no skulls, no pirates fighting; avoid objects the reference Seafaring and Diving sets already use (treasure chest, map, spyglass, anchor, ship wheel, captain hat, barrel, message in a bottle).

cards.main_colors: warm brass, red needle, cream face
cards.background: bright blue with radiating rays
cards.why: Finding the way to the lost island.
